question: After the lookup-self permission is documented and final-head behavior is shown, should this PR adopt the proposed Vault 403 classification contract for existing operator deployments?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes how ambiguous Vault authentication and ACL failures are surfaced; maintainers must confirm that the documented introspection requirement is the acceptable compatibility boundary.

options.title: Document and verify the contract
options.body: Add operator guidance for `auth/token/lookup-self` access and provide exact-head redacted runtime proof before merging.

options.title: Accept the undocumented boundary
options.body: Merge with current docs, accepting that custom-policy users may discover the aggregation distinction only through changed runtime diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Document and verify the contract
recommendation.body: Add operator guidance for `auth/token/lookup-self` access and provide exact-head redacted runtime proof before merging.
